name: open-marketplace
description: Open Marketplace: an AI-first marketplace where chat is the primary interface for buyers and sellers, and every marketplace action is also exposed to external agents over MCP.
author: BrandeisPatrick (https://github.com/BrandeisPatrick)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
